question: What practice over what time is enjoined for one who takes up an ochre robe free from bondage?
premises: One who does so should practice from six months onward.
The object or condition specified is the ochre robe free from bondage.
The tu particle marks emphasis on that person.
inference: One who takes up the ochre robe free from bondage should practice for six months.
uncertainties: Object of abhyas remains syntactically open
